Produmex Consultant
Company Description
Fonseca Advisers is an implementation technology company that provides comprehensive solutions tailored to the needs of customers in the commercial and manufacturing sectors. Our goal is to assist companies in achieving their strategic objectives of profitability, productivity, and competitiveness through consulting, support, and product development using adaptable, efficient, and cutting-edge methodologies.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote role for a Produmex Consultant at Fonseca Advisers. The Produmex Consultant will be responsible for implementing Produmex solutions, providing consulting services to clients, conducting system configurations, training end-users, and ensuring successful project delivery. The role involves collaborating with clients and internal teams to optimize business processes and enhance performance.Qualifications

Proficiency in Produmex solutions and SAP Business One
Experience in implementing, configuring and training Produmex add-on
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
Knowledge of warehouse management and supply chain processes
Relevant certifications in SAP Business One and Produmex are a plus
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field
US Visa B1/B2
Advanced English (B2/C1)

Location

Remote LATAM
Required to travel to clients’ sites.

Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm
